title: offline distilled behavior policy: CONTRACT_TARGET_NOT_TRAINED until a PairedDistillationDataset exists; canonical serialization; rankLabelDerivationV1 (auto-only pairwise ranks); splitRoleRemapV1 explicit family mapping; artifact schema binding by path+sha256.

authority.claimDetail: 本合同只冻结蒸馏策略的工件结构、训练算法、接受门与生产闭包；当前无训练数据、无已接受工件，不声称 80/164 可直接训练。

teacherClosure.rule: teacher 输出的 valueVector 永远不是生产特征；生产只消费 BehaviorImmediateFeatureV1 特征向量；raw teacher case 与特征之间无桥时显式 NOT_PAIRED。

authority.contractStatusNote: 合同文本冻结状态；顶层 status 是 schema 可表达的 artifact 状态（CONTRACT_TARGET_NOT_TRAINED），字段名不冲突。

canonicalSerializationV1.rule: compact UTF8 JSON (no insignificant whitespace); object keys sorted recursively by UTF-16 code unit ascending; array order preserved; -0 normalized to 0; NaN/Infinity rejected (validator FATAL, never serialized as null)
canonicalSerializationV1.note: 所有 hash 统一使用本规则；同一对象序列化结果确定且可复现。

trainingStatus.meaning: 当前不存在 PairedDistillationDataset；trainingFixtureHash/holdoutHash/modelHash 均不存在，禁止伪造；holdout top1 尚不可测量，任何 artifact 不得声称 ACCEPTED。
trainingStatus.gatesModelKindMeaning: 未训练状态下若出现 gates/modelKind，只是目标阈值与目标模型 kind 的声明，不代表 artifact、metrics 或 acceptance；artifactId/artifactHashes/normalization/linear/training/acceptance/determinism/closure 一律禁止出现（schema oneOf 强制）。

frozenTeacherPackage.purpose: teacher 身份由下列已冻结文件包定义；任何训练/标签生成/验收只能使用该包，生产闭包不得加载。
frozenTeacherPackage.teacherHashRule: SHA256(UTF8(canonicalSerializationV1 of {members: [{path, hash}]} sorted by path UTF-16 ascending)); artifact.teacherHash must equal the package hash of the frozen package in force at training time
frozenTeacherPackage.memberHashRule: member hash = SHA256(raw file bytes) of the pinned file, same rule as BehaviorImmediateFeatureV1.sourceHashes

unitIndex.meaning: 80 单元的 REFERENCE_LABEL_INTEGRITY_SET 索引（unitId/sourceCaseId/family/variant/sourceHash），本身不产生标签；其旧三角色 splitRole/validationTuning 字段只作为 80 单元来源，不控制模型训练（见 splitRoleRemapV1）。

rankLabelDerivationV1.purpose: 从 teacher 输出派生 pairwise rank 标签；只用于 auto 模式。
rankLabelDerivationV1.exclusionRule: manual/PLAYER_LOCKED 的 case 永不进入 top1 或 pairwise 训练；只进入机械合法性与硬排除审计。

v2.paretoDerivation: internalPareto = candidateId set of teacher pareto member objects（v2 evaluateRawCase.pareto）
v2.selectedNote: v2 selected = mode==='manual' ? eligible.find(playerLockedCandidateId) : pareto[0]；manual 不进入训练，auto 的 rank0 只取 selected.candidateId

v3.eligibleDerivation: internalEligible = candidate.eligible === true（等价 exclusionReasons.length === 0；exclusionReasons 已含 ILLEGAL 与 hardExclusionCodes）
v3.paretoDerivation: internalPareto = set(paretoCandidateIds)（v3 已按 UTF-16 升序排序的 ID 数组，取集合）
v3.selectedNote: v3 selected = mode==='auto' ? pareto[0] : manual 锁定候选；manual/PLAYER_LOCKED 不进入训练

unified.internalEligible: 按 v2/v3 各自 eligibleDerivation 得到的候选集合（单批数据只来自单一 teacher 版本；并集规则用于跨版本元数据核对）
unified.internalPareto: 按 v2/v3 各自 paretoDerivation 得到的候选集合
unified.rule: rank 标签只由 unified internal eligible/pareto 集合派生；v2/v3 原始字段名在摄入时精确映射一次，之后一律使用内部集合，不再按角色/技能名/原型名解释

rankLabelDerivationV1.eligible: unified internal eligible：v2 用 legal !== false && hardExclusionCodes.length === 0；v3 用 eligible === true（exclusionReasons 为空）。

ranks.rank0: selected（auto 模式下 teacher selected 必须是 Pareto 顶成员；selected 不在 Pareto 仅在 manual 模式允许，而 manual 不进入训练）
ranks.rank1: 其他 internal Pareto 成员（internalPareto 减去 selected.candidateId），同 rank
ranks.rank2: internal eligible 且不在 internalPareto（eligible dominated），同 rank

rankLabelDerivationV1.excludedFromPairs: ineligible/excluded（v2: legal === false 或 hardExclusionCodes 非空；v3: eligible === false 或 exclusionReasons 非空）不构成任何 pair，只进入 hardExclusionConsistency 审计。
rankLabelDerivationV1.pairRule: pairs 只跨 rank（rank0>rank1、rank0>rank2、rank1>rank2），同 rank 内不构成 pair；枚举按 candidateId UTF-16 升序稳定进行。
rankLabelDerivationV1.alternativesNote: teacher 的 partial alternatives（v2 alternatives 数组、v3 alternatives 数组）不作为 rank 标签；rank 只由 internal pareto 成员资格与 eligibility 派生。

splitRoleRemapV1.purpose: 被 pin 的旧 manifest 三角色（train/validation/acceptance）只作为 80 单元来源；模型训练/审计集合由本显式 family 映射决定。
splitRoleRemapV1.declaration: BehaviorProviderQualitySplitV1.json 的 splitRole 与 validationTuning 字段不控制模型训练；旧 validationTuning 语义作废。
splitRoleRemapV1.remapHashRule: SHA256(UTF8(canonicalSerializationV1 of splitRoleRemapV1.mapping))；仅对 mapping 对象求值（不含 remapHash 自身，避免自引用循环）；当前 remapHash 已按本规则复算一致。

referenceLabelIntegritySet.roleSourceNote: 其旧三角色仅作单元来源；权威集合映射见 splitRoleRemapV1。
referenceLabelIntegritySet.pairingStatusMeaning: raw teacher case 到 BehaviorImmediateFeatureV1 特征尚无桥；在桥与配对数据集生成前，这些单元只用于 teacher 标签完整性核对，绝不可当作生产特征或训练行；teacher valueVector 不得冒充生产特征。
referenceLabelIntegritySet.variantRule: 概念 family 含其全部 variant；family 绝不跨 train/calibration/mutationAudit/holdout 拆分；不允许跨训练/调参泄漏；mutation 族不参与任何调参；holdout 只做最终一次性评估。
referenceLabelIntegritySet.seedRuleMeaning: 以上 roleAssignment 表与 splitRoleRemapV1.mapping 即显式 family 映射；不使用 SHA256 parity 或任何 hash 推导分配。
referenceLabelIntegritySet.caseIdDisjoint: unitId/sourceCaseId 在四个集合间两两不相交。

pairedDistillationDataset.definition: 每行对应同一 candidateId，必须同时包含 (a) BehaviorImmediateFeatureV1 特征向量输出（schemaVersion const BehaviorImmediateFeatureV1）与 (b) teacher 标签：selected（candidateId 或 null）、rank（按 rankLabelDerivationV1 派生的 rank0/rank1/rank2 分组）、hardExclusion（boolean）。
pairedDistillationDataset.pairingRequirement: 同一 candidateId 缺少特征向量或缺少 teacher 标签的行不构成配对；raw teacher case 无特征桥时标 NOT_PAIRED 并排除。
consequences: 未生成前 trainingFixtureHash/holdoutHash 不存在，禁止伪造。
未生成前无法测量 holdout top1，任何 ACCEPTED 声明非法。
teacher valueVector 永远不作为生产特征；生产输入只有 BehaviorImmediateFeatureV1 特征向量。

featureInput.rule: 模型只按 mechanic featureCode 取特征；任何角色名/技能名/原型名作为权重的键都是 UNKNOWN_FEATURE_CODE。

artifact.artifactSchemaBinding: artifact.artifactSchemaHash must equal artifactSchema.hash; the schema never pins the contract (no cycle); equality is enforced by harness/self-check
artifact.featureSchemaHashRule: SHA256(raw file bytes) of tools/rc6/contracts/BehaviorImmediateFeatureV1.schema.json at training time
artifact.trainingFixtureHashRule: SHA256(UTF8(canonicalSerializationV1 of the train+calibration PairedDistillationDataset partition index (row candidateIds -> source path/hash list))); absent while NOT_GENERATED
artifact.holdoutHashRule: SHA256(UTF8(canonicalSerializationV1 of the holdout PairedDistillationDataset partition index)); holdout never participates in fitting or hyperparameter choice; absent while NOT_GENERATED
artifact.trainingAlgorithmHashRule: SHA256(UTF8(canonicalSerializationV1 of the trainingAlgorithm section of this contract))
artifact.artifactSchemaHashRule: SHA256(raw file bytes) of DistilledBehaviorPolicyV1.schema.json at training time; must equal artifactSchema.hash
artifact.modelHashRule: SHA256(UTF8(canonicalSerializationV1 of the artifact with modelHash omitted)); artifact is self-verifying

normalization.means: per-featureCode training mean over KNOWN values; features never seen in training are missing-masked
normalization.scales: per-featureCode training scale (standard deviation or declared scale); scale<=0 or absent means the feature is treated as missing
normalization.missingMask: featureCodes allowed to be missing (status UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE); masked features contribute 0 to the score and are never imputed as a real 0 value; HARD_EXCLUSION/HARD_EXCLUSION_REASON are always masked in training
normalization.nonFinite: FATAL reject (NON_FINITE_REJECTED); NaN/Infinity mean/scale/coefficient/value never accepted

modelKinds.rule: 本合同只定义 LINEAR_SCORE_V1 的工件与接受门；SHALLOW_GBDT_V1 属于未来独立升级，需要新 revision 定义其结构与门，本合同不伪造其通过。

trainingAlgorithm.rankLabels: rankLabelDerivationV1 (auto mode only; manual/PLAYER_LOCKED excluded from top1 and pairwise training)
trainingAlgorithm.featureMasking: HARD_EXCLUSION/HARD_EXCLUSION_REASON masked in training; hard exclusion is enforced by the pipeline rule independently at 100% consistency and is never learned as a score
trainingAlgorithm.objective: deterministic pairwise logistic rank (RankNet-style): pairs (i,j) with rank(i) > rank(j) per rankLabelDerivationV1; loss_ij = log(1 + exp(-(s_i - s_j))); total = mean over pairs + (lambda/2) * sum_f w_f^2
trainingAlgorithm.score: s(c) = intercept + sum over KNOWN features f of w_f * ((value_f - mean_f) / scale_f); masked/missing features contribute 0

optimizer.algorithm: full-batch gradient descent with analytic gradients

determinism.ordering: pairs enumerated in candidateId UTF-16 ascending order per rankLabelDerivationV1
determinism.rule: same PairedDistillationDataset and same pinned algorithm yield the same weights; no wall clock, no random source

trainingAlgorithm.hyperparameterChange: stepSize/iterations/l2Lambda are frozen in this contract; any change requires a new revision and a re-pinned trainingAlgorithmHash
trainingAlgorithm.reproducibility: with the frozen algorithm plus pinned trainingFixtureHash/holdoutHash/modelHash, training is reproducible; while PairedDistillationDataset is NOT_GENERATED no artifact may claim ACCEPTED

scoring.formula: score(c) = intercept + sum over KNOWN features f of coefficient[f] * ((value[f] - mean[f]) / scale[f])
scoring.missingHandling: UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE features are masked: they contribute 0 and are not imputed; scale<=0 or absent treats the feature as missing
scoring.determinism: same feature vector yields same score; no wall clock, no random, no hidden input
scoring.direction: higher score is better; ordering by descending score; exact ties break by candidateId UTF-16 ascending
scoring.exclusionOverride: model score never overrides HARD_EXCLUSION; excluded candidates keep their exclusion reason and never enter Pareto
scoring.clamp: score stays unclamped for ordering; no hardcoded normalization constant applied at scoring time beyond pinned mean/scale

gates.holdoutTop1Rule: holdout top1 agreement >= 0.90 with teacher ranking on the PairedDistillationDataset holdout partition; top1 uses rankLabelDerivationV1 ranks (rank0 selected) and excludes manual/PLAYER_LOCKED cases; below threshold the artifact is NOT_ACCEPTED and never registered; not measurable while the dataset is NOT_GENERATED
gates.hardExclusionRule: hard exclusions 100% consistent across all cases including manual/PLAYER_LOCKED: every candidate the teacher excludes is excluded by the pipeline, and no model score reverses an exclusion
gates.top3Rule: holdout top3 agreement and order agreement are recorded in the artifact but are not acceptance gates
gates.acceptance: ACCEPTED only when holdout top1 >= 0.90 and hardExclusionConsistency == 1.0 and modelKind == LINEAR_SCORE_V1 and every pin is present (including trainingAlgorithmHash and artifactSchemaHash)
gates.registrationGate: registration requires explicit approval outside this contract; accepted artifact alone never auto-registers
gates.noFakePass: SHALLOW_GBDT_V1 artifacts cannot claim ACCEPTED under this revision; any artifact with modelKind != LINEAR_SCORE_V1 has status NOT_ACCEPTED; while trainingStatus is CONTRACT_TARGET_NOT_TRAINED no artifact exists and none may claim ACCEPTED

trainingSplit.detail: 训练/调参/审计/验收按语义域 fixture family 隔离；权威映射为 splitRoleRemapV1（train->train，validation->calibration/mutationAudit，acceptance->holdout），与 referenceLabelIntegritySet.roleAssignment 一致；caseId/seed 不跨集合交叉；旧 manifest 的 validationTuning 字段不控制模型训练；mutationAudit/holdout 绝不参与任何调参；holdout 只测一次。

diversity.rule: distilled policy is a pure scoring function and never draws; seeded variety stays inside the near-equivalent band and is consumed by the provider via the existing seededRandomFact (BehaviorProviderV1 randomFact model: seed 64 hex + actualValue in [0,1), drawn only when band size >= 2)
diversity.bandSemantics: band membership follows BehaviorProviderV1 selectionSemantics (epsilon/delta equivalence band over the frozen dimensions)

complexity.note: C=candidates; F=features per candidate (bounded by BehaviorImmediateFeatureV1 caps, MAX_FEATURES_PER_CANDIDATE=256). Scoring is a single pass; training is bounded by cross-rank pairs in the paired dataset; no branch combination, no future traversal.

schemaCounterExamplesV1.purpose: 独立反例：用完整文档实例证明 schema 顶层 oneOf 的互斥性；harness 对每个 document 运行 DistilledBehaviorPolicyV1.schema.json 校验并比对 expectation。反例中的 hash 均为 0x00 占位字符串，只用于 schema 形状校验，不代表真实 artifact；真实工件的 hash 一致性由 artifactSchemaBinding 校验。

cases.description: 未训练分支允许 gates/modelKind，但只作为目标阈值/目标 kind 声明；不得出现任何 artifact 字段。
CONTRACT_TARGET_NOT_TRAINED 与任何 trained artifact 字段绝对互斥：出现 artifactId/artifactHashes 必须拒绝。
TRAINED_ARTIFACT 分支的最小合法文档：全部必填 pin 存在且无 trainingStatus；证明分支二可接受真实工件形状。
TRAINED_ARTIFACT 必须 not required trainingStatus：在 CE3 文档中加入 trainingStatus 后必须被拒绝，保证两分支绝对互斥。

selfConsistency: trainingStatus.status == CONTRACT_TARGET_NOT_TRAINED.
artifact.pins are exactly the seven required names (incl artifactSchemaHash).
artifactSchema.hash == SHA256(raw bytes) of DistilledBehaviorPolicyV1.schema.json.
frozenTeacherPackage member hashes match disk SHA256(raw bytes); packageHash recomputes under canonicalSerializationV1.
canonicalSerializationV1.variant == RECURSIVE_UTF16_KEY_SORT; packageHash/teacherHash/trainingAlgorithmHash/trainingFixtureHash/holdoutHash/artifactSchemaHash/modelHash/remapHash all use it.
trainingAlgorithmHashCurrent recomputes under canonicalSerializationV1 of the trainingAlgorithm section.

rankLabelDerivationV1: teacherFieldMapping v2 (legal+hardExclusionCodes+pareto) / v3 (eligible+exclusionReasons+paretoCandidateIds) map once to unified internal eligible/pareto sets; manual/PLAYER_LOCKED excluded from top1/pairwise training; ranks 0/1/2 defined from internal pareto/eligibility; pairs only across ranks; ineligible/excluded only in hardExclusionConsistency.

splitRoleRemapV1.mapping totals match referenceLabelIntegritySet.roleAssignment (24/14/16/26 = 80); remapHashRule = SHA256(UTF8(canonicalSerializationV1 of splitRoleRemapV1.mapping)) and remapHash recomputes under it; old manifest splitRole/validationTuning fields never control model training.

schemaCounterExamplesV1: CE1 VALID、CE2 INVALID、CE3 VALID、CE4 INVALID（未训练分支允许 gates/modelKind 仅作目标声明；trained artifact 字段与 CONTRACT_TARGET_NOT_TRAINED 绝对互斥；TRAINED_ARTIFACT not required trainingStatus）。
allowedTeachers v2 unitCount == 74 and v3 unitCount == 6; attribution matches evaluatorAttribution.
pairedDistillationDataset.status == NOT_GENERATED; trainingFixtureHash/holdoutHash absent until generated.
trainingAlgorithm hyperparameters frozen; trainingAlgorithmHashRule defined.
gates.holdoutTop1 == 0.90 and gates.hardExclusionConsistency == 1.0.
scoring formula references only pins, means/scales and coefficients.
diversity consumes only the provider seededRandomFact; no second random source.
teacherClosure.productionClosureForbidden contains teacher/oldR8/oldKernel/routeCode/resultWorld/worldClone/wallClock/hiddenState/skillRoleNameWeighting; teacherValueVectorNotFeature true.
complexity is O(C*F) with fixed caps and no branch exponential.
sourceHashes match disk SHA256(raw bytes).
top-level status == CONTRACT_TARGET_NOT_TRAINED (schema-enumerable, truthful); authority.contractStatus == FROZEN holds the contract-freeze state under a non-conflicting field name.
artifactDocument.document validates against DistilledBehaviorPolicyV1.schema.json (CONTRACT_TARGET_NOT_TRAINED branch, gates/modelKind as target declarations only).

artifactDocument.purpose: schema-valid view of the current document against DistilledBehaviorPolicyV1.schema.json (top-level status + trainingStatus + target declarations only; no artifact fields exist while untrained)
